messages:
maria: Hey all — PR #59112 updates prefetch eviction + fallback routing. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/59112. Need runtime, infra, platform, and security eyes before we can schedule canary. Target canary: Wed 11:00am PT. Quick summary: reduce prefetch TTL, add KV fallback on miss, change authz header ordering for performance.

sam: @maria I can take runtime review today. will check perf impact on hot-paths. :+1:

kevin: I'll grab infra (alloc/eviction + test infra). please attach perf artifacts from the CI run. also curious about expected allocation delta.

alisha: Security here — header reorder could affect authz checks in a couple edge cases. can you add a short threat-model + justification in the PR description? pinging @security for extra eyes. :eyes:

jordan: @maria can you drop a minimal rollback/runbook snippet in the PR? need to confirm canary quota and fallback behavior if things spike.

maria: Added the runbook and perf artifacts to the PR, pushed a small follow-up commit addressing inline comments. also bumped the eviction config default: `--prefetch-ttl` from 60 -> 30.

maria: ```
diff --git a/runtime/eviction.go b/runtime/eviction.go
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ func initEviction() {
-    ttl := 60
+    ttl := 30
 }
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for Wed 2025-03-12T18:00:00Z by @maria (canary-window: 1h).

sam: skimmed the runtime changes — left two tiny nits around nil-checks and a comment. overall looks fine and I left a high-level LGTM; will re-run microbench locally.

kevin: infra LGTM pending CI flakes. saw one allocator test flake in `alloc_test.go::TestLRU` — not related but CI will need a green run before merge.

alisha: starting security review now. please add the specific request: use-case that required header reorder + what regressions we've tested. also include any external callouts (OSS libs) if relevant.

maria: thanks — re: rollback: runbook snippet added to PR description. rollback steps: 1) flip `routing.fallback_enabled=false`; 2) revert canary via deploy tool; 3) restore previous TTL config.

sam: if runtime + infra + sec mark LGTM by EOD I'll cut the canary and be on-watch for the first 30m. can someone volunteer to be canary steward?

jordan: I can steward the canary window. will coordinate with SRE for escalation.

maria: awesome, thanks @jordan. tagging @alisha for final sec ack. if we get green CI and sec ack today, i'll request merge window. :rocket:
